title: The Spruce Goose flew once
caption:
Howard Hughes built the biggest plane of its time out of wood. It flew once, for less than a minute. 🪵✈️
Wartime metal shortages pushed the H-4 Hercules into birch laminate; a 97 m wing got it off the water, but only about 20 m up for about a mile.
Legendary engineering or the most expensive boat ride ever?
first_comment: Built a plane, flew it a mile, never touched it again. Most of us do that with gym memberships 🏋️
sources: Evergreen Aviation & Space Museum, 'The Spruce Goose': the Hughes H-4 Hercules flying boat, built mostly of birch because of wartime metal shortages; wingspan 320 ft (97.5 m); its only flight was on 2 November 1947 at Long Beach

Wikipedia, 'Hughes H-4 Hercules': the flight reached about 70 ft (21 m) for about 26 seconds over roughly one mile; Hughes testified before the Senate War Investigating Committee in 1947 about the use of government funds; it never flew again
